board.title: Fleet board
board.callCustomer: Call the customer — the vehicle has not come back.
board.allCurrentSub_one: {{count}} vehicle, nothing expiring in the next {{days}} days.
board.allCurrentSub_other: {{count}} vehicles, nothing expiring in the next {{days}} days.

vehicles.limitReached: Vehicle limit reached ({{current}}/{{max}}). Ask your provider to raise it.

newVehicle.title: New company vehicle
newVehicle.garageNote: This vehicle is filed in the organization's garage: fleet managers can see it and it counts against the organization's allowance. It is not added to your personal garage.
newVehicle.limitReached: {{org}} has reached its vehicle limit. Ask your provider to raise it before adding another vehicle.

noHistory.fleet: This vehicle has never been assigned.
noHistory.rental: This vehicle has never been rented out.

detail.cancelExplain: Cancelling is not returning. Use it when the vehicle never went out; if it came back, mark it returned instead.

costs.outliersExplain: These vehicles cost more than {{factor}}× the fleet median ({{median}}) per kilometre. Start here.
costs.noDistance: No fuel or trip data, so cost per kilometre cannot be calculated.

people.removeExplain: Their access ends immediately and any vehicle they hold is released. Their history is kept.
people.inviteOnce: This link is shown once — copy it and send it to them yourself. If you lose it, issue a new invitation; the old link stops working.

customers.title: Customers
customers.name: Name
customers.deleteExplain: Their personal data and every contract of theirs is permanently erased. This cannot be undone.
customers.deleteWithOpen_one: This customer has {{count}} open contract. Deleting also deletes it and releases the vehicle. This cannot be undone.
customers.deleteWithOpen_other: This customer has {{count}} open contracts. Deleting also deletes them and releases the vehicles. This cannot be undone.

import.title: Import vehicles from CSV
import.intro: Upload the list you already have. Turkish headers, semicolon-separated Excel files and dd.mm.yyyy dates all work. You get a preview first; nothing is written until you confirm.
import.noFile: Choose or paste a CSV first.
import.missing: Fields this file does not carry: {{fields}}
import.blockedErrors_one: {{count}} row has an error. The file is imported whole or not at all — fix it and upload again.
import.blockedErrors_other: {{count}} rows have errors. The file is imported whole or not at all — fix them and upload again.
import.blockedLimit: Your organization's ceiling is {{max}} vehicles. You have {{current}} and this file adds {{adding}} more.
import.blockedEmpty: The file has no rows to import.

errors.plate_exists: This plate is already in the fleet.
errors.duplicate_plate_in_file: This plate appears more than once in the file.
errors.nickname_required: Nothing in this row identifies a vehicle.
errors.invalid_km: That odometer reading is not valid.
errors.invalid_date: Date could not be read (dd.mm.yyyy expected).

invite.title: Organization invitation

explain.driver: When you join you will see only the company vehicle assigned to you. Your own vehicles and their records stay yours.
explain.manager: When you join you can see the organization's vehicles, documents and costs. Your personal garage stays separate.

invite.wrongAccount: This invitation is for {{invited}} but you are signed in as {{current}}. Sign in with the right account and open the link again.
invite.unusableSub: The link may have expired, been revoked, or already been used. Ask whoever invited you for a new one.

disclosure.title: Company vehicle: what you record is visible to your employer
disclosure.subtitle: This vehicle belongs to {{org}}. Before you carry on, here is what is shared.

shared.route: The route of the trip on the map
shared.times: When the trip started and ended
shared.records: The fuel, odometer, document and maintenance records on the vehicle

notShared.personal: Your own personal vehicles and the trips you record on them
notShared.liveRide: Your live position in a group ride — that is never shared with an organization

disclosure.permission: The location permission is on your device and under your control. You can decline it, or withdraw it at any time in iOS Settings, and the app still works. What your job requires of you is between you and your employer.

errors.mode_mismatch: That action doesn't apply to how this organization is set up.
errors.mode_change_blocked: The mode can't be changed while assignments or contracts are still open.
errors.vehicle_already_assigned: This vehicle is already assigned to someone.
errors.vehicle_already_rented: This vehicle is already out on rent. Close the open contract first.
errors.member_not_found: That person is not an active member.
errors.end_km_before_start_km: The closing odometer can't be lower than the opening one.
errors.return_km_before_handover: The return odometer can't be lower than the handover one.
errors.ends_before_start: The return date can't be before the start date.
errors.contract_not_open: That contract is no longer open.
errors.last_owner: An organization must keep at least one owner.
errors.already_member: That person is already a member.
errors.owner_role_required: Only an owner can make changes involving the owner role.
errors.invite_not_found: That invitation wasn't found. The link may have been revoked or mistyped.
errors.invite_already_accepted: That invitation has already been used.
errors.invite_email_mismatch: That invitation was sent to a different email address.
errors.no_recognised_columns: None of the columns were recognised. It may be the wrong file, or the delimiter may need setting by hand.
errors.import_invalid: The file has invalid rows, so none of it was imported.
errors.import_empty: The file has no rows to import.
